Backup / Restore

Everything in this app lives only on this device's browser storage — there's no cloud copy. If this browser's data is ever cleared, or this device is lost, everything is gone unless you've exported a backup file first. Export regularly.

Saves your full catalog, print queue, batches, and settings to a file you keep — Google Drive, a USB stick, wherever you'd trust with the only copy.

Then use "Import Excel / CSV" in the online version — the columns match automatically.

Replaces everything currently on this device with what's in the file. Use this to move to a new device, or recover after a problem.

Deletes the entire catalog, print queue, and every saved batch from this device. Export a backup first if there's any chance you'll want this data again.

Choose your ticket paper

Pick the sheet that matches your paper. The drawings are to scale. Not sure? Count the tickets on one sheet and search for that number, e.g. "30".

Measure one ticket with a ruler, count the tickets across and down, and measure from the top and left edge of the sheet to the first ticket. The gaps between tickets are worked out for you.
